units.source_text: 竹河左大臣逝世后，夕雾右大臣升任左大臣，红梅大纳言以左大将兼任右大臣。

en.t: After the Takekawa Minister of the Left passed away, Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, was promoted to Minister of the Left, and Kobai, the Grand Counselor, while also serving as Captain of the Left, became Minister of the Right.

units.source_text: 其次人等，各有晋升：薰中将升任中纳言；三位中将升任宰相。

en.t: The others likewise received promotions: Captain Kaoru was promoted to Middle Counselor, and the Captain of the Third Rank became a Councillor.

units.source_text: 在这时代，庆祝升官晋爵的，只限于这一家族的人，此外似乎就没有其他人了。

en.t: In this age, those celebrating promotions in office and rank seem to have been limited to this one family; apart from them, there was apparently no one else.
